component.name: SayItErmano
component.summary: Local voice dictation with AI polish

description.p: SayItErmano is a dictation app for Linux: press a key, speak, and the polished text lands in any app. Speech-to-text runs 100% locally (Whisper); an optional AI-polish step can clean up raw transcripts through a provider you configure.

The unofficial community Linux port of FluidVoice (macOS); not affiliated with the upstream project. History, a native GTK 4 settings app, dictation learning and multi-language cycling are built in. Works on X11 and on Wayland via the freedesktop portals (GlobalShortcuts hotkey, RemoteDesktop/EIS text insertion — GNOME 48+, Plasma 5.27+, Hyprland).

ul.li: Hold-to-talk or toggle dictation with a global hotkey
Local Whisper transcription; models download on first run
Optional AI polish through your own provider and key
Searchable history with export; audio retention is optional
